facts.fact: 搬回老家的当天，Billie 走进镇上那家亮着淡紫字招牌的古董店 Good Vintage，才发现这是前男友 Sean 的（他母亲的）店。
facts.anchor: It’s the antique shop—Sean’s antique shop.

facts.fact: 自从九年前在她车里道别后，Billie 与 Sean（前男友）首次重逢。
facts.anchor: It’s been nine years since we were together last. Since we said goodbye in my car.

facts.fact: Sean 解释：母亲工时减少，他留在 Lakewood 替母亲继续经营这家店，而不是像 Billie 以为的那样去 reenlist in the army 或创业。
facts.anchor: “Yeah, my mom couldn’t do as many hours anymore, but she loves this place, so I keep it going for her.”

facts.fact: Billie 主动约 Sean 明早在教堂样子的咖啡馆见面，他答应（约在九点）。
facts.anchor: I ask again quickly, before I can back out of my own thought. “Will you meet me for coffee tomorrow morning?”

facts.fact: 晚上八点父亲就已回房（疑似躲着女儿），Billie 便去车库取回满是凹痕的旧记忆盒。
facts.anchor: he’s already disappeared into his room and it’s only eight o’clock.

facts.fact: 记忆盒里有 Sean 参军 basic training 期间寄来的八封信：每月一封，越写越严肃，不再署名画小心心，也不再说两人的未来。
facts.anchor: He’d sent eight letters total, and each letter became more serious and less romantic.

facts.fact: 转折揭晓：Sean 停止写信是因为 Billie 从未回信；她读信落泪，想借明天的咖啡弥补当年为自保而伤他的事。
facts.anchor: I know why he stopped sending them. It’s because I never wrote back.
